purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor boundary for inspecting memory records, provenance, scope, lifecycle and retrieval traces while keeping mutations behind explicit authorized memory operations.

topics.name: Memory Monitor
topics.purpose: Define a read-only Expose monitor/editor boundary for inspecting memory records, provenance, scope, lifecycle and retrieval traces while keeping mutations behind explicit authorized memory operations.

semantics.edit_rule: Create/update/remove controls, if exposed, invoke separate explicit Memory operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing a record does not grant write/delete authority.
semantics.redaction_rule: Restricted memory content/metadata is redacted according to scope/policy.
semantics.trace_rule: Retrieval trace shows which memory refs were projected into which consumer context where policy permits.
semantics.layout_rule: UI grouping/order does not create memory relations or priority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant memory is explicit addressable provenance-bearing data; retrieval and storage never create hidden authority or implicit execution.

hard_gates.condition: monitor directly mutates memory without explicit operation
UI order creates memory relevance/priority semantics

references.purpose: Memory Monitor follows generic monitor non-authority semantics.
Monitor may display bounded retrieval traces.
